units.source_text: “只给这点儿……”舞女说着，把手里攥着的五角钱银币放在阿妈的手掌上。

en.t: Only this much... the dancing girl said, placing the fifty-sen silver coin she had been clutching into her mother's palm.

units.source_text: 我又朗读了一会儿《水户黄门漫游记》。

en.t: I read aloud from The Travels of Mito Komon for a little while longer.

units.source_text: 她们又谈起宝宝在旅途中夭折的事来。

en.t: They began talking again about the baby who had died during the journey.

units.source_text: 据说，千代子生的婴儿十分苍白，连哭叫的力气也没有。

en.t: They said that the baby Chiyoko had given birth to was terribly pale and did not even have the strength to cry.

units.source_text: 即使这样，他还活了一个星期。

en.t: Even so, he still lived for a week.
